conviction_note: One finding: registered PIPE resale supply (29.16M shares at an implied ~$12.00, freely saleable since the S-1 went effective 2026-09-10) is the only identifiable seller, nothing dated lands in the window to stop it, and the fall carries no news. I sized it at -1.0 and took it to -0.8 because today's 0.52x volume sits in the band where the base rate is positive (+1.46%). That offsets part of the name's own history (median -2.81) and its 13% ATR.

cause.what_happened: No news, filing or press release on the drop day (EDGAR's latest filing is the 2026-09-10 EFFECT; the company's news page shows nothing after 2026-08-05). This is the third straight down day (-10.24% on 09-23, -12.12% on 09-24, -6.79% at 15:04 ET today) on 0.52x normal volume, grinding toward the ~$12.00 PIPE price. That pattern fits steady distribution of the 29.16M PIPE shares whose resale registration went effective 2026-09-10. The attribution is inferred from the supply and the tape, not from a disclosed sale.

evidence.claim: The $350.0M concurrent PIPE was issued as 29,165,559 common shares, implying ~$12.00 a share; 61,727,211 shares were outstanding after the merger. The 180-day lock-up covers only nine named directors and officers.
The S-1 is a resale registration of up to 29,164,045 shares for the PIPE selling stockholders, sold at market prices, including block transactions.
The resale S-1 was declared effective (EFFECT accepted 2026-09-10 15:05 UTC); there have been no filings since.
The latest company news releases are dated 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-05, with nothing in September.

pipeline.next_dated_event: Nothing dated inside the window. The D&O lock-up expires about 2027-01-30 (180 days after the 2026-08-03 closing); NSCLC data is guided to 1H 2027.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A 13G/A or Form 4 showing a large PIPE holder has exited or added, or a company release or conference presentation dated 2026-09-28.

positioning_check: Nasdaq/FINRA short interest was 253,084 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement (1.0 days to cover), up 210.7% from 81,457 on 2026-08-31. That is about 0.4% of the ~61.7M shares outstanding (8-K, 2026-08-03). The data lags about 8 business days, so the position carried into this week's fall is not observable. findings.finding: PIPE holders can keep selling on Monday 2026-09-28: 29.16M shares (about 47% of the 61.7M outstanding) are registered for resale at market prices since 2026-09-10, against a 20-day median of about $7.4M (~0.5M shares) a day, so the overhang is dozens of sessions of normal volume and is not spent.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration is effective now, so any holder can sell, or cross a block, in the 2026-09-28 session. No lock-up covers the PIPE investors (the 180-day lock-up names only nine D&O holders), and the company has announced nothing that would give the tape a buyer that day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the resale went effective the name has fallen from ~$17.96 (the 2026-09-11 quote in a search snippet, dated before the screen) to $12.50. The next-close outcomes of its post-effective falls were +3.73 (09-10), +0.88 (09-15), -12.12 (09-23) and -6.79 (09-24), all taken from the sealed baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: The close prices what has been sold so far, not what is still registered and unsold. If the market held the seller as finished we would expect today's volume to spike and the price to turn at the $12 PIPE cost. Instead volume is 0.52x, the pattern of a patient seller working an order across days, and 29M saleable shares against ~0.5M shares a day cannot have cleared in eleven sessions.
findings.independence: The EDGAR submissions feed shows the EFFECT accepted 2026-09-10 and nothing since, so the company has not answered the fall (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0002130606.json). The 8-K confirms the PIPE share count and that the lock-up is limited to D&O (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130606/000119312526330810/d309963d8k.htm).

outside_window.finding: Nine directors and officers are locked up for 180 days from the 2026-08-03 closing, so that supply is released around 2027-01-30.
Amsoki-cel (OBX-115) Phase 1 NSCLC data is guided to 1H 2027 and topline registration-enabling melanoma data to year-end 2027. Cash of ~$350M is guided to fund operations into 2H 2028.
Spot $12.50 is about 4% above the ~$12.00 implied PIPE price. That level could slow PIPE selling if holders will not sell below cost, but it has no date or named buyer, so it is not a mechanism.

baseline_tension: The finding agrees with this name's own history of falls (median -2.81, 33% up) and its 13% ATR, but it cuts against today's 0.52x volume, the band where the base rate is +1.46%. I therefore set expected_move_pct at -0.8, 0.2 below the -1.0 finding sum, and the three-day losing streak on thin volume is read as distribution rather than news.
